hero_desc: I am Pedro, a young self-taught developer fascinated by cybersecurity, Linux, and automation. I dedicate my time to learning and applying technology to practical solutions, always seeking improvement. I love dismantling systems to deeply understand how they work under the hood. This is my digital space where I share my evolution journey and what I'm building.
section_projects_desc: Applications and automation solutions that I developed to apply practical concepts.
eco_desc: A gamified ecological sustainability web application developed to explore community engagement and practical web development learning.
eco_details: EcoChat was built as part of my learning journey. The objective was to explore gamification concepts applied to sustainability, encouraging ecological habits in daily life. The project challenged me in the practical integration between the backend in Flask (Python) and the reactive interface in React (Vite). For data persistence, I used SQLite, which helped me understand relational modeling of user tables, tasks, and scores in a simplified and efficient way.
cinema_desc: A project aimed at understanding the classical MVC architecture and access control, simulating the management and reservation of cinema rooms.
cinema_details: Developed as an academic project, Cinema MVC was an excellent opportunity to explore the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architectural pattern using ASP.NET Core and C#. The technical focus was to understand data isolation business rules and access security. To prevent overbooking in real-time seat reservations, I learned to use Entity Framework Core to ensure consistent and secure database transactions.
brain_desc: My terminal assistant configured with the Claude Code CLI to optimize and automate my daily study workflow.
brain_details: LyraBrain was born from my desire to explore the power of autonomous assistants in development. I configured the Claude Code CLI to interact with my local study directories, read log files, and run quick infrastructure scripts. This sandbox helped me deeply understand workflow automation concepts in the terminal, allowing me to focus my time on what really matters: learning complex concepts.
section_dev_desc: Active prototypes and sandboxes where I'm testing new ideas, architectures, and interfaces.
feijoeiro_desc: A premium institutional portal designed for a nursery. A great sandbox to refine my UI/UX and animation skills using the Intersection Observer API.
casa_desc: Initial repository where I am studying and structuring the bases of a clean and sustainable modular systems architecture.
footer_desc: I'm always open to exchange ideas, share learning experiences, or discuss cybersecurity, automation, and development. Feel free to reach out!
